name: Cardenete (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, grey above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cardenete (a tree, a chalice and a ruined castle).
history: Municipal flag of Cardenete; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cardenete arms — tree, chalice and ruined castle
